automated_checks.follow_up: The 9 ChatGPT-plan tests also passed after adding a regression assertion for the browser-tested same-origin Referrer-Policy. The only subsequent implementation change made the speech probe's en-US voice filter mandatory; the final script was rerun successfully.

oauth.probe_limits: Fixed tiny prompt, 45-second local timeout, 1 MB response limit; max_output_tokens is unsupported by the plan preview, so this is not a hard token/spend cap
browser_findings: Initial local form POST was denied. Changing the page's Referrer-Policy from no-referrer to same-origin allowed the actual browser to supply the required Origin while preserving cross-origin referrer suppression. Exact Origin and CSRF checks remain enforced.

OpenAI account selection initially returned HTTP 400 Invalid content type. The normal Try again action and automatic security verification recovered; the account-selection flow then reached final consent. No CAPTCHA was solved and no security control was bypassed.

local_speech_output.note: Sandbox attempts could not access SAPI; the approved run succeeded without changing Windows security settings. This is a candidate output engine, not a final speech selection.

limitations: Final OAuth consent remains an owner decision at the actual permission screen. No subscription inference, active production route or selected model entitlement is claimed.
